title: form.js per-file preflight visibility fix (a named Perkins r1 regression) ships with no pinning test at any level
evidence:
+    // .field-error is display:none by default — without this the per-file
+    // message was written into an invisible span (found by Perkins r1:
+    // a per-file-only block then showed nothing at all).
+    errorEl.style.display = "flex";  |||  SKILL.md:207: "- `client_block` → page stayed on the form (no `confirmation-page`, no `error-summary`); the field's inline `field-{name}-error` span is populated by client-side preflight (`form.js` reading `data-per-file-message` / `data-aggregate-message`)."
detail: The only E2E assertion (client_block) checks the span is populated — textContent the buggy code also set — so it passes under the regression. scripts/js-tests holds only apply_analytics/form_stepper tests (grep: no data-preflight-error/display coverage). The SSR twin of this same regression got a pin (upload_slot_error_renders_visibly_test); the client twin didn't. AGENTS.md: tests defend named regressions.
recommended_fix: Add a node --test for form.js's setInlineError/clearInlineError display toggling, or extend the client_block assertion in form-bug-hunt SKILL.md to check computed visibility, not just textContent.

title: {MOVE_IN_DATE} sweep broke the too-far-future boundary scenario it explicitly exempts — upper-bound date rule loses its E2E pin
evidence:
expected_outcome: validation_error
expected_error_fields:
  - desired_move_in_date
...
  desired_move_in_date: "{MOVE_IN_DATE}"  |||  SKILL.md:279: "Only the boundary-validation scenarios (`desired-move-in-date-in-past`, `-too-far-future`) pin literal dates on purpose."  |||  application_handler.gleam:1114: "/// Validate `desired_move_in_date` against today + a 12-month ceiling."
detail: {MOVE_IN_DATE} = today+90d, valid under the 12-month ceiling, so the scenario can never produce the expected desired_move_in_date error — it gets confirmation and goes red, contradicting the same diff's SKILL.md exemption. Unit pin (validate_move_in_date_too_far_future_test, 2099-01-01) remains; E2E pin is gone.
recommended_fix: Restore a literal far-future date (e.g. 2030-01-01) in desired-move-in-date-too-far-future.yaml, matching its own description and the SKILL.md boundary exception.

title: Stepper error re-render path (start-at-first-error, error-summary anchor click-through routing) has no E2E — only pure-function unit pins
evidence:
+// Runs on both the pristine form (data-apply-page="form") and the
+// validation-error re-render ("form-errors") — error-summary anchor links
+// point at fields inside now-hidden sections, so the stepper starts at the
+// first error's section and routes those clicks through a step switch.  |||  stepper-happy-path.yaml: "expected_outcome: confirmation\nstepper: true"
detail: scenarios/stepper/ contains only stepper-happy-path (the sole stepper:true scenario; expected_outcome: confirmation). firstErrorIndex/resolveAnchorTarget/focusTargetFor are js-test pinned and SSR anchors Gleam-pinned, but the live click-handler glue against real SSR hrefs is untested end-to-end (~80% P1).
recommended_fix: Add a stepper:true scenario with expected_outcome: validation_error that follows an error-summary anchor into a hidden section and asserts step switch + focus.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% (happy path pinned in both layouts; server validation, upload caps, no-JS fallback all covered). P1 ≈ 90% aggregate but with one named regression (form.js preflight visibility) at 0% and stepper error-rerender routing partial; overall ≥80%. Per AGENTS.md, an unpinned named regression outweighs raw percentages.
recommended_fix: Pin the form.js display:flex regression (unit or E2E visibility assertion), restore the literal far-future boundary date, and add a stepper:true validation_error scenario — that lifts the gate to PASS.
